sections.heading: 5. TinaCloud PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-126/commits-2.png)

Total Commits processed by TinaCloud over the last 6 months, total commits (aka spits) over the last month was 42,006 (up 28% on the previous period) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-126/onboarding.png)

User onboarding over the last 7 days - our conversion metric is the share who go on to commit. New accounts were 8% last Sprint and are now 10% (13 of 129). Invited collaborators were 26% and are now 22% (26 of 117) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-126/projects.png)

Organisation and project creation over the last 7 days - 139 new organisations, up from 133 last Sprint - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

sections.heading: 6. TinaCMS PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-126/dau.png)

Daily active users this month - peaking at 705 on 29 Sep (dips are weekends) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)

![](/uploads/sprint-126/geo-2.png)

Distribution of unique TinaCMS users over the last 30 days - US is our top country with 1,657 users, up 101 on the prior 30 days, ahead of Germany on 615 and the UK on 486 - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)
